blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models must predict how an environment evolves under sequences of actions, enabling agents to compare possible futures and reason about counterfactual actions before acting. Long-horizon prediction is commonly obtained by recursively applying a one-step transition model, but intermediate errors can compound over time. Multi-step dynamics models instead condition on a sequence of future actions and predict their consequences directly, but become harder to learn as horizon grows: the model must track interacting state changes across the trajectory, endpoint supervision provides weak credit assignment, and intermediate predictions can remain plausible while losing information needed for later states. We show that these challenges can be addressed by casting the internal evolution of a multi-step transition as structured reasoning over textual world states: reasoning over sparse state changes reduces the burden of state tracking, a predictive-gain objective rewards the learned state for improving over a matched predictor that conditions on raw history instead, and intermediate predictive rewards supervise each state along the trajectory. Because these intermediate states are explicit textual representations of the world, they provide semantically meaningful targets that can be inspected, scored, and corrected during training. Across ScienceWorld , Jericho , and CEO-Bench , our approach achieves the strongest average long-horizon performance against recursive and non-recursive baselines that condition directly on raw history, with gains increasing at longer horizons: at horizon 10, it exceeds the strongest such baseline by 12.3% relative on ScienceWorld and 9.3% relative on CEO-Bench , and error on Jericho drops by nearly 30%. In a controlled counterfactual study, our model is also the only one with statistically significant sensitivity to future actions ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), while baselines show null or anti-correlated sensitivity once ground-truth geometry is accounted for. These results suggest that making a multi-step transition’s internal trajectory explicit and supervisable through structured reasoning is a better abstraction for long-horizon textual world modeling than recursively composing one-step predictions.
blocks.zh: 世界模型必须预测一个环境如何在行动顺序下演变,使代理人在采取行动之前能够比较可能的未来和反事实行动的理由。 长视距预测通常通过递归性地应用一阶过渡模型来得到,但中间误差会随着时间的推移而复合. 多步骤动态模型而是以一系列未来行动为条件,直接预测其后果,但随着地平线的增长而变得难以学习:该模型必须跟踪整个轨迹的相互作用状态变化,端点监督提供弱的信用分配,中间预测仍然可能存在,同时会丢失后期状态所需的信息. 我们表明,这些挑战可以通过将多步骤过渡的内部演进作为结构化推理而不是文字化世界状态来解决:对稀有状态变化的推理减轻了状态跟踪的负担,一个预测-回报目标奖励所学状态改善于一个匹配的预测器,即原始历史条件,中间预测奖则监督每个状态沿着轨迹走. 由于这些中间状态是世界的明确的文字表述,它们提供了精密有意义的目标,可以在训练期间被检查,打分并被纠正. 整个科学世界,杰里科,以及CEO-Bench, 我们的方法实现了最强的长视距平均性能, 直接取决于原始历史的回溯性和非回溯性基线, 在更长的地平线上收益增加: 在地平线10, 它超过了最强的基线, 比科学世界的12.3%, 比CEO-Bench的9.3%, 杰里科的错误下降了近30%。 在一项受控反事实研究中,我们的模型也是唯一一个对今后行动具有统计上显著敏感性的模型(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),而基线显示,一旦计算出地真几何,则无效或与地真相关敏感性。 这些结果表明,通过结构化推理使多步骤过渡的内部轨迹明确化并可以管理,比起递归式地形成一步骤预测,长相间的文字世界模型更能抽象化.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models enable agents to reason about the consequences of their actions before interacting with an environment. For language-based agents, this requires predicting how an environment will evolve under a sequence of actions from observations that reveal only part of the underlying world state ( Li et al., 2026b ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Zuo et al., 2026 ) . A common approach is to learn a one-step transition model and recursively roll it forward, feeding each predicted state back into the model to produce the next ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ) . This factorization is convenient and naturally exposes intermediate states, but it also creates a fundamental weakness: errors in an intermediate prediction become part of the context for every subsequent transition and can therefore compound with horizon ( Asadi et al., 2019 ; Lambert et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 世界模式使代理人在与环境互动之前能够对其行动的后果作出解释。 就基于语言的物剂而言,这需要预测环境将如何在仅揭示世界基本状况一部分的观测结果的一组行动下演变(Li等,2026b; Gu等,2025;Li等,2026c;Zuo等,2026.). 一种共同的方法是学习一个一步骤的过渡模型并相继地向上滚动,将每个预测状态反馈到模型中以产生下一个状态(Hafner等,2019;Hafner等,2020.). 这种因子化是方便的,自然地暴露出中间状态,但也造成了一个根本的弱点:中间预测中的出错成为了以后每一个过渡的上下文的一部分,因此可以与地平线相复合(Asadi等,2019;Lambert等,2021.).

blocks.en: Non-recursive prediction offers an alternative. Rather than repeatedly applying a learned one-step transition to its own predictions, prior work directly predicts a future state at a target horizon from the current state and future action sequence ( Asadi et al., 2019 ; Lambert et al., 2021 ) . The difficulty is that long-horizon prediction is inherently multi-horizon: training a single direct model to accurately cover many horizons is challenging, while training separate models for different horizons fragments the data and prevents shared learning across them. These limitations are especially consequential in partially observable environments, where the model must preserve information from history while tracking action-dependent changes over many steps.
blocks.zh: 非回溯性预测提供了一个替代办法。 之前的工作不是再三将所学到的一步步的过渡运用到自己的预测中去,而是直接从当前状态和未来动作序列中预测出目标地平线上的未来状态(Asadi等,2019;Lambert等,2021). 困难在于长视线预测本质上是多视线的:训练一个单一的直接模型以精确地覆盖许多地平线是具有挑战性的,而训练不同地平线的单独模型则会分解数据并阻止它们之间的共享学习. 这些限制在部分可观察的环境中尤为严重,在这种环境中,模型必须从历史中保存信息,同时跟踪许多步骤中依赖行动的变化。

blocks.en: The challenge, then, is to retain the benefits of non-recursive prediction while recovering the shared structure across horizons that direct endpoint prediction tends to discard. Rather than treating each horizon as a separate prediction target, we model the entire multi-step evolution as a single structured trajectory. Concretely, we cast this trajectory as reasoning over textual world states, where each action induces a sparse change to an otherwise persistent state (Figure 1 ). This representation allows the same transition to support predictions at multiple horizons while making the internal evolution explicit. In this sense, direct endpoint prediction and our approach parallel the distinction between an LLM answering immediately and an LLM reasoning through a chain of thought before answering ( Wei et al., 2022 ) : rather than free-form scratch text, however, our intermediate reasoning takes the form of an explicit, semantically grounded world-state trajectory that can itself be supervised and rewarded.
blocks.zh: 因此,面临的挑战是保留非再预测的好处,同时恢复直接终点预测往往放弃的跨地平线共享结构。 我们不把每个地平线当作一个单独的预测目标,而是将整个多步骤演化过程模拟为一个单一的结构化轨迹. 具体地说,我们把这一轨迹描绘成对文字世界国家的推理,在文字世界中,每项行动都会导致对否则的持久性状态的微小改变(图1)。 这种表述方式允许同样的过渡,支持多地平线的预测,同时明确内部演化. 从这个意义上说,直接的终点预测和我们的方法与LLM即时回答和LLM推理的区别平行,通过一个连串的思考来回答(Wei等,2022年):然而,我们的中间推理不是自由形式的抓取文字,而是采取明确、凝聚地立足的世界国家轨迹的形式,其本身可以监督和奖励。

blocks.en: This structure also addresses the main difficulties of learning long-horizon dynamics jointly. Reasoning over sparse state changes reduces the burden of tracking interacting updates across a long action sequence while preserving unaffected facts. Exposing intermediate states provides semantically meaningful targets for supervision and process rewards, allowing errors to be localized throughout the trajectory rather than only at its endpoint. Finally, optimizing the predictive gain of the learned state over a matched predictor that conditions on raw history instead encourages it to retain information that may only become useful for downstream observations. Together, these mechanisms allow a single multi-step transition to share learning across horizons while avoiding recursive state feedback. Although the underlying language model remains autoregressive over tokens, predicted intermediate world states are not recursively fed back into separate transition calls.
blocks.zh: 这一结构还解决了共同学习长视野动态的主要困难。 国家变化过多的原因减少了在长期行动序列中跟踪互动更新,同时保留未受影响的事实的负担。 暴露中间状态为监督和处理奖励提供了明确有意义的目标,使错误在整个轨迹中发生,而不仅仅是在其终点。 最后,将所学状态的预测收益优化于匹配的预测器,即原始历史条件鼓励它保留可能只对下游观测有用的信息。 这些机制共同使单一的多步骤过渡能够跨地平面分享学习,同时避免递归状态反馈. 虽然基本语言模式仍然比标语自动递减,但预测的中间世界国家不会被递归地反馈到单独的过渡呼叫中.

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on three partially observable interactive domains with complementary long-horizon dynamics: ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , Jericho ( Hausknecht et al., 2019 ) , and CEO-Bench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . latent-SR achieves the strongest average long-horizon prediction performance across all three, with its advantage concentrated at longer horizons, and is also the only evaluated model with statistically significant action-conditioned sensitivity in a controlled counterfactual study, while baselines are null or significantly negative after correcting for ground-truth branch geometry. Ablations and controlled perturbations further separate the effects of transition factorization, training, and intermediate supervision, supporting a trajectory-explicit, non-recursive transition as a practical alternative to recursively composing one-step predictions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们在三个部分可见的互动领域采取的方法,这些互动领域具有相辅相成的长期动态: 科学世界(Wang等,2022年),杰里科 (Hausknecht等,2019年),和CEO-Bench(Chen等,2026年). 潜伏-SR实现所有三个领域最强平均长视距预测性能,优势集中在更远的地平线上,也是在受控反事实研究中唯一具有具有统计重要性的行动条件敏感性的被评价模型,而基线在纠正地平线分支几何后为无效或显著负. 疏导和有控制的扰动进一步区分了过渡入计量、培训和中间监管的影响,支持轨迹明确、不重复的过渡,作为递归式组合一步骤预测的实用替代办法。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Predictive states under partial observability. When the current observation does not fully characterize the environment, an agent must summarize its history into a state sufficient for future prediction. In POMDPs, this role is formalized by the belief state ( Kaelbling et al., 1998 ) , while predictive state representations define state directly through action-conditional predictions of future observations ( Littman et al., 2001 ; Singh et al., 2004 ) . Learned recurrent and latent state-space models integrate past observations and actions into representations that mediate future dynamics ( Downey et al., 2017 ; Hafner et al., 2019 ) , and information-state formulations characterize when such a representation can recursively replace the full history ( Subramanian et al., 2022 ) . The prediction horizon also affects what these representations retain: multi-future supervision distinguishes states with identical immediate outcomes ( Dedieu et al., 2024 ) , and future-observation prediction improves history representations for memory and reasoning ( Kwon et al., 2024 ) . These works motivate our use of long-horizon prediction as supervision for the latent state, not merely as an evaluation target.
blocks.zh: 部分可观察的预测状态。 当目前的观测不能充分描述环境时,一种物剂必须将其历史总结为足以进行未来预测的状态. 在POMDPs中,这种作用由信仰状态正式确定(Kaelbling等,1998年),而预测状态表述则通过对未来观测结果的行动条件预测直接定义状态(Littman等,2001年;Singh等,2004年)。 所学的反复出现和潜在的状态空间模型将过去的观察和行动纳入调解未来动态的表述(Downey等,2017年;Hafner等,2019年),以及信息状态的表述,当这种表述能够递归地取代完整的历史(Subramanian等,2022年)。 预测的地平线也影响到这些表述所保留的内容:多未来监督区分了具有相同即时结果的状态(Dedieu等,2024年),而未来观察预测则能改善记忆和推理的历史表述(Kwon等,2024年). 这些工作促使我们利用长视距预测作为潜在状态的监督,而不仅仅是作为评价目标。

blocks.en: Long-horizon dynamics in latent world models. Many world models for visual and control domains encode observations into fixed-dimensional continuous latents and learn a shared one-step transition, obtaining longer predictions by recursively applying it ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) . This reuses the same dynamics model across horizons and exposes intermediate states, but repeated rollout can amplify local errors. The Dreamer line of latent-imagination agents ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2021 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) and value-equivalent planning with a learned model ( Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ) are prominent instances at scale. Multi-step rollout objectives address error accumulation while retaining recursive dynamics: latent overshooting supervises predictions across multiple rollout distances ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) , self-predictive representations recursively predict future latents ( Schwarzer et al., 2021 ) , and joint-embedding predictive models ( LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) train on their own intermediate predictions ( Terver et al., 2026 ) . A complementary line instead changes the temporal factorization: direct multi-step models predict a farther-future state from the current state and action sequence ( Asadi et al., 2019 ; Lambert et al., 2021 ) , with related work supporting variable horizons, direct endpoint prediction, or action-level temporal abstraction ( Du et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Park et al., 2026 ) . These establish direct prediction as an alternative to deep recursive rollout, but target continuous latent spaces and predict only the endpoint state; our transition instead exposes an action-aligned intermediate state trajectory within the same non-recursive call, making the trajectory itself available for supervision.
blocks.zh: 潜在世界模型中的长视野动态. 许多视觉和控制域的世界模型将观测编码为固定维相连续潜入,并学习共享的一步过渡,通过递归应用获得较长的预测(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018). 这样可以跨地平线重复使用相同的动态模型并暴露出中间状态,但反复推出可以扩大局部出错. 潜想剂的梦想者线(Hafner等,2019年;Hafner等,2020年;Hafner等,2021年;Hafner等,2023年)和与学习模型的等值规划(Schrittwieser等,2020年)是规模化的突出例子. 多步骤推出目标解决误差累积问题,同时保留回转动力:潜在过度射出监督跨多步推出距离的预测(Hafner等,2019年),自预测表示回转预测未来潜在(Schwarzer等,2021年),以及联合嵌入预测模型(LeCun,2022年;Assran等,2023年;Bardes等,2024年)自行进行中间预测的列车. (Terver等,2026年). 一条补充线转而改变时间因子化:直接多步骤模型预测从当前状态和行动序列中更远的未来状态(Asadi等,2019;Lambert等,2021),相关工作支持可变地平线,直接终点预测,或行动层面的时间抽象(Du等,2026;Li等,2026a; Park等, 2026 (英语). 这些设定了直接预测,作为深度回转推出的替代方案,但针对的是持续的潜在空间,并仅预测终点状态;而我们的过渡则暴露了同一非回转呼中与行动相适应的中间状态轨迹,使轨迹本身可供监督.

blocks.en: Text world models and textual latent states. Text world models use language models to predict action-conditioned outcomes from an interaction context or state ( Li et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , with recent work on web interaction, next-state prediction, and heterogeneous agent environments ( Gu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Zuo et al., 2026 ) . Unlike continuous latents, textual states share their modality with the history, actions, and predicted observations. To ensure the learned state carries the information needed for prediction, our framework conditions prediction on the history only through this state. Generating a textual state requires the model to explicitly select and restate its contents, so important facts may be omitted during encoding or regeneration. The sequential structure of text also lets an action sequence and its state updates fit within a single LLM context, making joint multi-step transition a natural alternative to recursive prediction. Motivated by this, we develop a framework for learning future-predictive textual states and evolving them through structured multi-step updates over long horizons.
blocks.zh: 文本世界模型和文本潜在状态。 文本世界模型使用语言模型预测一个相互作用背景或状态的有行动条件的结果(Li等,2026年b;Gao等,2026年),最近的工作涉及网络相互作用,邻态预测,以及多种剂环境(Gu等,2025年;Li等,2026年c;Zuo等,2026年). 与连续潜伏不同的是,文字状态与历史、行动和预测的观测模式相同。 为了保证学得的状态带有预测所需的信息,我们的框架条件只能通过这种状态来预测历史. 生成文本状态需要模型明确选择并重述其内容,因此在编码或再生过程中可能省略出重要事实. 文本的相继结构也让一个动作序列及其状态更新适合一个单一的LLM上下文,使联合多步骤过渡成为递归预测的自然替代. 以此为动力,我们制定了学习未来预测性文本状态的框架,并通过结构化的多步骤更新来逐步形成这些文本状态。

blocks.en: 3.3 Empirical Probes of Compounding Error
blocks.zh: 3.3 化合物误差的试验

blocks.en: Recursive and non-recursive transitions differ in how errors can propagate across the horizon. Under recursive rollout, an erroneous intermediate state becomes input to later calls; under a non-recursive transition, no predicted state is re-entered in this way. We probe this difference from two complementary angles.
blocks.zh: 递归性和非递归性转变在错误如何横跨地平线传播方面有所不同. 在递归式推出下,一个错误的中间状态会变成对后继呼叫的输入;在非再生过渡下,没有预测状态会以这种方式再被重入. 我们从两个互补的角度来探寻这种差异。

blocks.en: First, we compare matched recursive and non-recursive models while holding backbone, data, and training recipe fixed within each stage. The non-recursive transition achieves higher long-horizon accuracy across stages, and the gap persists as training improves (Section 5.3 ). Second, we inject a fabricated fact into the latent state and track its effect with horizon. Recursive rollout continues to carry the perturbation, whereas its effect attenuates under structured reasoning (Section 5.4 ). Together, these probes motivate a non-recursive transition with explicit intermediate structure.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们比较对应的递归模式和非递归模式,同时掌握每个阶段固定的骨干、数据和培训配方。 非反向过渡使各阶段的长距离精确度提高,随着培训的改善,差距继续存在(第5.3节)。 第二,我们把一个捏造的事实注入潜在的状态,并追踪其影响。 递进式推出继续带来干扰,而其效果在结构化推理下会减弱(第5.4节)。 这些探测器共同激发出具有明确中间结构的非再生过渡.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Section 3.1 defines the encode–transition–decode factorization, and Section 3.2 distinguishes recursive, direct, and structured-reasoning (SR) transitions. We instantiate encoding, transition, and decoding with a shared autoregressive policy π θ \pi_{\theta} using stage-specific prompts. Our method has two components: (i) a replayable sparse-edit representation that exposes the internal multi-step trajectory without recursive feedback, and (ii) trajectory-level training that supervises both intermediate and terminal predictive quality.

blocks.en: 4.2 Training the Textual World Model
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训文字世界模式

blocks.en: The training data contain interaction histories, actions, and observed outcomes, but no reference textual states or edit trajectories. In particular, the latent transition is unobserved: much like intermediate reasoning traces, there is no ground-truth sequence of states or edits to imitate directly. We therefore train in two stages. First, we distill high-quality model-generated trajectories to initialize the structured latent computation. We then apply trajectory-level reinforcement learning, which optimizes those latent trajectories through their predictive consequences.
blocks.zh: 培训数据包含互动历史、行动和观测结果,但没有参考文本状态或编辑轨迹。 特别是,潜在的过渡是无法观察的:与中间推理痕迹一样,没有直接模仿状态或编辑的地基真实序列。 因此,我们分两个阶段进行培训。 首先,我们提炼出高质量的模型生成的轨迹来初始化结构化的潜在计算. 然后我们进行轨迹级强化学习,通过预测结果优化这些潜在的轨迹。

Because these latent traces are not ground truth, we retain only candidates whose terminal observation prediction exceeds a quality threshold and whose encoded state, edit sequence, and decoded observation satisfy the required formats. The accepted traces are then used as supervised distillation targets for the corresponding stages. Appendix C.2 gives the backbone, distillation data construction, and training objective.

blocks.en: This distillation stage provides a structured initialization rather than a final learning objective: it teaches the policy to produce coherent latent states and edit trajectories before reinforcement learning evaluates and improves them based on predictive outcomes. Without such an initialization, malformed or uninformative latent trajectories can dominate early rollouts and obscure the learning signal.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Trajectory-Level Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 轨迹强化学习

blocks.en: Rollout-based credit assignment. Because the textual states and edits are discrete sampled sequences, we optimize them through their predictive consequences using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . We sample a rollout tree with branching factors ( b enc , b trans , b dec ) (b_{\mathrm{enc}},b_{\mathrm{trans}},b_{\mathrm{dec}}) . Each complete rollout receives a scalar reward, and each interior node is assigned the mean reward of its descendants. Siblings under the same parent form the group for computing group-relative advantages, yielding stage-specific learning signals for encoding, transition, and decoding from the same trajectory-level outcome. Appendix C.3 gives the full reward definitions, including the variants used in the ablation of Section 5.3 ; Appendix C.4 lists training hyperparameters and compute.

Environments and Datasets .
We study three partially observable interactive text environments: ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , Jericho ( Hausknecht et al., 2019 ) , and CEO-Bench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . For each environment, we collect complete interaction trajectories using diverse policies and split them into disjoint training and test sets at the trajectory level before constructing prediction examples. Dataset construction and statistics are provided in Appendix A .

我们研究三个部分可见的交互式文本环境: 科学世界(Wang等,2022年),杰里科 (Hausknecht等,2019年),和CEO-Bench(Chen等,2026年). 对于每一种环境,我们利用不同的政策收集完整的交互轨迹,在构建预测实例之前,将它们分为轨迹层面的脱节培训和测试集. 数据集构建和统计见附录A。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Protocol .
To isolate rollout horizon from target-specific difficulty, we use fixed-target evaluation. For each target observation o T o_{T} , a horizon- k k prediction starts from the interaction history at step T − k T-k and conditions on the intervening actions a T − k : T − 1 a_{T-k:T-1} . Predictions across horizons therefore share the same target and differ only in rollout distance. On ScienceWorld and CEO-Bench we evaluate learned variants at k = 1 , … , 10 k=1,\ldots,10 ; on Jericho , whose fixed-target set supports longer rollouts, at k ∈ { 1 , 5 , 10 , 15 , 20 } k\in\{1,5,10,15,20\} . Every table and ablation in this paper reports Avg. over a shared subsampled grid ( k ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 , 7 , 9 , 10 } k\in\{1,3,5,7,9,10\} for ScienceWorld / CEO-Bench , all five horizons for Jericho ) so that every model’s average is comparable across tables. ScienceWorld is evaluated with Fact-F1 and BLEU (Appendices B.1 – B.2 ), and Jericho with BLEU and Score MAE, an absolute error on the game’s internal score. For CEO-Bench , we use SE-score over cash, individual subscribers, enterprise seats, and open issues; Appendix B.3 gives the full definition. All metrics are multiplied by 100 100 for readability except Jericho Score MAE, which is left on its native scale.

blocks.en:
Baselines .
We compare five learned world-model variants defined in Section 3 : obs-recursive , obs-direct , latent-recursive , latent-direct , and latent-SR . The obs-* variants condition directly on the interaction history, whereas the latent-* variants operate on the learned predictive state. Comparing obs-recursive with obs-direct isolates recursive versus non-recursive prediction without a learned latent state; comparing latent-direct with the matched-reward latent-SR ablation isolates the structured transition, while the full latent-SR additionally evaluates the benefit of intermediate-state supervision (Section 5.2 , Appendix C.2 ); and latent-recursive provides the recursive latent counterpart. All learned variants use the same backbone, collected trajectories, data split, and evaluation protocol (Appendix D.1 ). We additionally include GPT-5.2 (Appendix D.2 ) and, on CEO-Bench , Copy-last and learned time-series forecasters (Appendix D.3 ).
blocks.zh:
基线
我们比较了第3节定义的五个世界模型变体:阴暗反射、阳暗反射、阴暗反射和阴暗反射。 obs-*的变体直接取决于相互作用的历史,而潜在-*的变体则在所学到的预测状态上运作。 将隐蔽性与隐蔽性直接隔离相提并论,在没有学到的潜伏状态下进行回溯性预测与非回溯性预测相提并论;将隐隐性直接与相匹配的回溯性潜在-SR通缩相提并论,将结构化过渡隔离出,而完全隐性-SR额外评价了中间状态监督的好处(附录C.2,第5.2节);而隐性-回溯性提供了回溯性潜在对应物。 所有已学习的变体都使用同一种主干,所收集的轨迹,数据分解,以及评价协议(附录D.1. 此外,我们还包括GPT-5.2(附录D.2)和CEO-Bench(附录D.3)、复制最后文本和学习时间序列预测器(附录D.3)。

The selected time-series model is Chronos-2 with four target variables and 27 future-action covariates. It observes the same prefix and, where supported, future actions, but never future observations. These oracle-selected baselines are marked with † in Table 2 and Table 1 ; complete configurations are provided in Appendices D.2 and D.3 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Overall performance .
Across ScienceWorld (Table 2 ), Jericho (Table 3 ), and CEO-Bench (Table 1 ), latent-SR achieves the strongest average performance on every metric, with gains concentrated at longer horizons: at h ​ 10 h10 , it exceeds obs-direct by nearly 10 Fact-F1 and 13 BLEU points on ScienceWorld , and by about 7 SE-score points on CEO-Bench . On Jericho , obs-recursive leads at the shortest horizons ( h ​ 1 h1 , h ​ 5 h5 ) on both BLEU and Score MAE, but latent-SR overtakes it from h ​ 10 h10 onward and attains the best average on both metrics.
blocks.zh:
总体业绩.
纵观科学世界(表2)、杰里科(表3)和CEO-Bench(表1),潜在-SR在每个衡量标准上都取得了最强的平均业绩,收益集中在较长的地平线上:在h 10 h10时,它超过了科学世界近10个事实-F1和13个BLEU点,在CEO-Bench上超过了大约7个SE分。 在杰里科,在BLEU和分数MAE上最短的地平线(h 1 h1,h 5 h5)有模糊的回路,但潜伏的SR从h 10 h10上超过了它,在两个度量标准上都达到了最佳平均值.

blocks.en:
Qualitative case studies .
Appendix G gives paired examples illustrating these gains at the prediction level: obs-direct tends to reuse or extrapolate the most recent matching observation, while latent-SR reflects information that has since changed—retaining object availability after intervening failed actions in Jericho , updating the predicted room after an unobserved move in ScienceWorld , and tracking accumulated subscriber loss over sustained cancellations in CEO-Bench rather than returning a stale snapshot.
blocks.zh:
定性案例研究.
附 录 G给出了在预测层面说明这些进展的对等例子:obs-direct倾向于重复使用或推断最新的匹配观测结果,而潜入SR则反映了后来变化的信息——在干预杰里科的失败行动后保留对象可用性,在ScienceWorld无人观察的举动后更新了所预测的房间,跟踪CEO-Bench持续取消而导致的累积用户损失,而不是还原一时的快照.

blocks.en:
Full-system comparison .
The gap between obs-direct and latent-SR combines the latent state, structured transition, and training objectives, so Section 5.3 separates these factors. latent-direct (same representation and training through predictive gain, but a direct transition) reaches 89.16/87.63 (Fact-F1/BLEU) on ScienceWorld and 83.53 SE-score on CEO-Bench —ahead of obs-direct but well below latent-SR (92.44/92.37 and 87.35). latent-SR (Ours) additionally uses the mid reward that latent-direct lacks; at the matched predictive-gain stage, latent-SR ’s own ablations reach 86.58 SE-score on CEO-Bench (Table 4 ) and 91.91/91.10 (Fact-F1/BLEU) on ScienceWorld (Table 10 ), so the transition architecture accounts for most of the gap over latent-direct , with the mid reward contributing a smaller remainder up to the full model’s 87.35 and 92.44/92.37.

全系统比较.
第5.3节将这些因素分开。 潜在直接(通过预测收益实现相同的代表性和培训,但直接过渡) 89.16/87.63(Fact-F1/BLEU)关于科学世界,83.53 SE得分在CEO-Bench上——一首直接但远远低于潜伏的SR(92.44/92.37和87.35)。 潜在-SR(我们的)还使用了潜在-直接缺乏的中奖;在相匹配的预测-回报阶段,潜在-SR自身积分在CEO-Bench(表4)和91.91/91.10(Fact-F1/BLEU)上分别达到86.58 SE-分数,在科学世界(表10)上,过渡架构占了潜在-直接差距的大部分,中奖为完整模型的87.35和92.44/92.37贡献了较小的剩余部分。

blocks.en: Recursive prediction and other baselines . obs-recursive degrades more sharply with horizon than obs-direct ; Section 5.3 and the perturbation study in Section 5.4 examine whether this persists when representation and training are held fixed. GPT-5.2 degrades substantially at longer horizons despite test-set prompt selection; on CEO-Bench , Copy-last is competitive at short horizons but deteriorates as action-dependent changes accumulate, while the selected time-series model trails the learned world-model variants.
blocks.zh: 递归预测和其他基线 第5.3节和第5.4节的扰动研究审查了在举行代表和培训固定时这种情况是否继续存在。 GPT-5.2在较长的地平线上大幅降解,尽管测试设置即时选择;在CEO-Bench上,Copy-last在短地平线上具有竞争力,但随着依赖动作的变化累积而恶化,而所选择的时间序列模型会跟踪所学出的世界模型变体.

The relevant perturbation harms every model, whereas the irrelevant distractor has near-zero effect (Table 5 ), showing the intervention is selective rather than generic corruption. For latent-recursive , it causes an 8–14 point SE-score loss across horizons (11.1 average); the average loss is 5.4 for latent-SR after distillation and 1.7 for the full model.
blocks.zh: 扰动损害在再起时持续存在,但在潜伏的SR下则较小。 相关的扰动伤害了每个模型,而无关的分心器则具有接近于零的效果(表5),表明干预是选择性的,而不是一般的腐败. 对于潜在再现性,它造成8至14分SE-分数的跨地平线损失(平均11.1分);蒸馏后的潜在再现性平均损失为5.4分,而整个模型平均损失为1.7分。

blocks.en: latent-recursive repeatedly turns predicted intermediate states into inputs to later transition calls, so an erroneous fact can persist across calls; latent-SR instead conditions a single multi-step generation on the original z t z_{t} without recursively re-entering reconstructed states. This does not by itself identify the internal mechanism, but is consistent with reduced propagation through recursive feedback.
blocks.zh: 潜在-再现性反复地将预测的中间状态转化为对后期过渡性状态的输入,因此一个错误的事实可以持续跨调;而潜在-SR则在原z t-z-t}上为单一多步生成提供了条件,而不会递相再入重建状态. 这本身并不确定内部机制,而是与通过递归反馈减少传播相一致。

blocks.en: Trajectory RL further improves robustness. Holding the latent-SR architecture fixed, trajectory training reduces mean perturbation damage from 5.4 after distillation to 1.7 in the full model, while clean SE-score increases from 83.2 to 87.1 on the same subset. Thus the robustness gain is not obtained by simply degrading the model’s clean prediction quality.

blocks.en: Aggregate accuracy does not show whether a model’s predictions actually track the supplied action sequence. We test this on CEO-Bench by forking a shared history into three branches ( aggressive growth , cost cutting , resample control ) that diverge by horizon 10, and asking each model to predict one branch’s outcome given only that branch’s actions.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We propose latent-SR, a non-recursive textual world-model transition that predicts sparse state edits in a single call and reconstructs intermediate states deterministically for supervision. Across ScienceWorld , Jericho , and CEO-Bench , it achieves the strongest average long-horizon prediction performance, with larger gains at longer horizons. Controlled comparisons further show reduced sensitivity to propagated state errors and improved action-conditioned counterfactual prediction. These results support structured, trajectory-explicit latent transitions as a promising alternative to recursive one-step rollout.
Our experiments focus on textual, partially observable simulated environments; whether the same factorization benefits visual or continuous world models, or improves downstream closed-loop planning, remains open.
blocks.zh:
我们提出潜在的SR, 一种非重复的文字世界模式的过渡, 预言在一次呼叫中, 在科学世界,杰里科,以及CEO本奇, 它实现了最强的平均长视距预测性能, 更大的收益在更长的视野。 控制下的比较进一步显示,对所传播的状态错误的敏感性降低,行动条件反事实预测也有所改善。 这些成果支持有条理、有条理的潜在过渡,作为递归性一步推出的一种有希望的替代办法。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies textual world models in simulated interactive environments ( ScienceWorld , Jericho , and CEO-Bench ) and does not involve human subjects, personally identifiable information, or crowdsourced data collection. All environments and models used are either publicly available research benchmarks or synthetic simulations; no proprietary or sensitive data is used. CEO-Bench is a synthetic business-simulation environment and does not involve real companies, individuals, or financial data. We are not aware of any direct harms, dual-use concerns, or fairness/bias issues specific to this work beyond those generally associated with training and evaluating large language models.
blocks.zh: 这部作品研究模拟互动环境中的文字世界模型(Science World, Jerico,和CEO-Bench),不涉及人类主体,个人可识别信息,或众包数据采集. 所有使用的环境和模型要么是公开提供的研究基准,要么是合成模拟;不使用专有或敏感数据。 CEO-Bench是一个合成的商业模拟环境,不涉及真正的公司,个人,或财务数据. 除了一般与培训和评价大型语文模式有关的问题外,我们没有意识到任何直接的伤害、双重用途的关切或这项工作特有的公平/偏见问题。

blocks.en: We describe our environments, dataset construction, and evaluation protocol in Section 5.1 and Appendix A , including trajectory collection policies, train/test splits, and the fixed-target evaluation procedure. The model architecture and training procedure (distillation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning, including the full reward formulation) are described in Section 4 , with backbone models, hyperparameters, and compute details in Appendix C.4 . Baseline implementations, including the baselines conditioned directly on raw history, GPT-5.2 prompting protocol, and numeric forecasting baselines, are detailed in Appendix D , and the exact prompt templates used for every architecture are given in Appendix F . Evaluation metric definitions (Fact-F1, BLEU, SE-score) are given in Appendix B , and the adjusted-margin counterfactual evaluation methodology is detailed in Appendix E.3 .

blocks.en:
CEO-Bench .
Each step corresponds to one simulated week, in which the agent files actions for a simulated company. Each observation reports the company’s business state, including cash, individual subscribers, enterprise seats, and open issues.
Beyond these four scored “level” fields, each observation additionally reports 12 “dynamics” fields describing the week’s flows and service health (new individual/enterprise leads, new individual subscribers, new enterprise seats, cancellations, upgrades, downgrades, p95 latency, error rate, outage and overload indicators), plus 4 “config” fields that carry forward the agent’s own action choices from the previous step (price, capacity, ops spend, dev spend) — these config fields are predicted and fed back into history but are not scored. The action space is the CEO agent’s choice of these same 4 levers each week (continuous values, parsed from free text), i.e. 4 action types per step.

首席执行官本奇

除了这四个得分的 " 级别 " 字段外,每项观察还报告12个 " 动态 " 字段,说明本周的流量和服务健康(新的个人/企业领导、新的个人订户、新的企业席位、取消、升级、降级、p95延迟、误差率、停产和超载指标),加上4个 " 配置 " 字段,这些字段从前一步骤(价格、能力、业务支出、支出等)推进代理人自己的行动选择——这些配置字段预测并反馈到历史,但没有得分。 动作空间是CEO代理每周选择这些相同的4个杠杆(持续值,从自由文本中解析),即每步4个动作类型.

blocks.en: A.2 Trajectory Collection

blocks.en: For each environment, we collect complete interaction trajectories using diverse policies. ScienceWorld : two base policies, oracle (an optimal task solver) and methodical (a systematic but non-optimal explorer), each also run in a noisy variant that mixes in a fraction of random actions ( epsilon_greedy_0.1 : 10% random deviation from the oracle; noisy_* : added action noise on top of either base policy), for 6 realized policy variants total. The training split has 540 trajectories (oracle 62, noisy_oracle 123, methodical 67, noisy_methodical 121, epsilon_greedy_0.1 63, noisy_epsilon_greedy_0.1 104) and the test split has 60 (same 6 policies), with a maximum episode length of 40 steps. Jericho : five policies — expert (walkthrough replay), random_walk (uniform random over valid actions), epsilon_greedy (walkthrough with a 30% chance of a random action at each step), explore_then_oracle (5 random warm-up steps, then walkthrough), and failure_modes (walkthrough with early truncation to also cover failure states). The evaluation set uses 7 games × \times 4 independent seeded rollouts each (28 trajectories), with a maximum episode length of 60 steps. CEO-Bench : trajectories are full simulated company histories (one action-observation pair per week) under the CEO agent’s own policy, run for up to roughly 52 weeks; 165 companies are used for training and 67 held out for test.

blocks.en:
Trajectories are split into disjoint training and test sets at the trajectory level before any prediction example is constructed, so histories from the same trajectory never appear in both splits. Each prediction example is indexed by a trajectory i i , a base step t t , and a horizon k k . Its input consists of the interaction history up to step t t and the action sequence ( a t , … , a t + k − 1 ) (a_{t},\ldots,a_{t+k-1}) , and its target is the observation o t + k o_{t+k} .
For fixed-target evaluation, test examples are grouped by the target step T = t + k T=t+k , so that predictions at all horizons for the same target are evaluated against the same o T o_{T} .
A target step T T is kept for the fixed-target test set only if every horizon k = 1 , … , H k=1,\ldots,H ( H = 10 H=10 for ScienceWorld/CEO-Bench, H = 20 H=20 for Jericho) has a valid base step t = T − k t=T-k within the same trajectory, so the test set forms a rectangular anchor-by-horizon grid with no missing cells; this is why the number of test targets (Appendix A.4 ) is smaller than the number of eligible base steps. Training examples are not required to satisfy this full-horizon-coverage constraint, since only the test protocol needs every horizon scored against the same target; horizons k k for training examples are instead sampled non-uniformly per environment (CEO-Bench’s training pool, for instance, is weighted toward k ∈ { 1 , 5 , 10 } k\in\{1,5,10\} ).

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价计量

blocks.en: B.1 Fact-F1
blocks.zh: B.1 事实-F1

blocks.en: Facts are extracted from observation text with an environment-specific parser ( delphi.metrics.eval_observation ) into predicate strings (e.g. room identity, container contents, device/substance state, numeric measurements). Predicted and reference fact sets are matched greedily in three passes: (1) exact predicate-and-argument matches; (2) numeric predicates matched under a small relative tolerance (5%, with a small absolute floor, so near-identical measurements are not penalized for formatting/rounding differences); (3) remaining reference facts with placeholder arguments matched structurally against remaining unmatched predictions. The matched count is the true positives; precision is true positives over the number of predicted facts, recall is true positives over the number of reference facts, and Fact-F1 is their harmonic mean, averaged over all test examples at each horizon.
blocks.zh: 事实取自带有环境特有解析器的观测文本(delphi.meters.eval_observation)为上弦(如房间身份,容器内装物,设备/物质状态,数值测量等). 预测和参考事实集在三个行经中贪婪相配:(1) 准确的上游和辩证匹配;(2) 在较小的相对耐受度下相配的数字上游(5%,有小的绝对下限,因此近同位素测量不会因格式/四舍五入而受到惩罚);(3) 其余的参考事实与占位符论点结构上相配,与其余未匹配的预测相配。 相匹配的计数是真实的正数;精度是真实的正数,相对于预测的事实数,回忆是真实的正数,相对于参考的事实数,而Fact-F1是它们的谐音平均值,平均为每个地平线上所有测试实例.

Predicted and reference text are lowercased and whitespace-tokenized after stripping chat-template special tokens and markdown code fences. BLEU-4 is used by default, but the effective n-gram order is capped at min ⁡ ( 4 , | o ^ | , | o | ) \min(4,|\hat{o}|,|o|) so that short one-line observations (common in Jericho, e.g. “Taken.”) are not forced to a score of zero purely because they are shorter than 4 tokens; NLTK’s SmoothingFunction method 1 is applied.

blocks.en: B.3 SE-score
blocks.zh: B.3 SE分数

blocks.en: CEO-Bench observations describe the state of a simulated company, and the quantities that matter most for evaluation are numeric. Token-overlap metrics such as BLEU compare numbers as strings and do not reflect how far a predicted value is from the true one. We therefore evaluate CEO-Bench predictions with SE-score, which measures the relative error on four key state fields.

The floor of 100 in the denominator keeps fields with small true values, such as the number of open issues, from producing disproportionately large relative errors: when | y i | < 100 |y_{i}|<100 , the error is measured relative to 100. The cap at 1 bounds each field’s contribution, so a single badly mispredicted field cannot dominate the score. SE-score therefore lies in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and equals 1 only when all four fields are predicted exactly.
If a prediction cannot be parsed at all, every field’s error term is set to 1 (i.e. SE = 0 \mathrm{SE}=0 for that example) rather than the example being dropped from the mean, so that unparseable generations at long horizons cannot quietly inflate the average by shrinking the denominator. If a prediction parses but an individual field cannot be recovered as a number, that field’s error term alone is set to 1, while the remaining fields are still scored normally.
We report the average SE-score over all test examples at each horizon, multiplied by 100.

blocks.en:
All learned variants ( obs-recursive , obs-direct , latent-recursive , latent-direct , latent-SR ) use Qwen3 [ Yang et al., 2025 ] as the backbone.
All learned variants, including the latent-SR SFT/distillation stage, are fine-tuned from Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. Distillation data for latent-SR is constructed by rejection sampling: a teacher policy (GPT-5.2, best-of- N N sampled) generates complete encode–transition–decode traces on the training set (Section 4.2.1 ), producing a per-action edit list at the transition stage (Appendix F ), and candidates are filtered to those whose terminal observation prediction and intermediate stage formats meet a quality threshold. The retained traces’ free-text reasoning is stripped, leaving each stage’s final structured output (state / per-action edit list / observation text) as the supervised target. Training uses the standard next-token cross-entropy SFT objective over these targets, rendered as multi-turn chat-format messages matching the encode/transition/decode call structure.

Branch construction .
From a shared interaction history and encoder state at step t 0 t_{0} , we generate three 10-week continuations under different policy directives: aggressive growth (spend to acquire), cost cutting (preserve cash), and resample control (no additional steering). Each directive is used only to generate the branch’s actions and simulated outcomes; the directive itself is never shown to the model. This counterfactual set comprises 60 source trajectories, generated from a separate simulator run and disjoint from the main CEO-Bench train/test split (Appendix A.4 ). We refer to it as the early-branching set, since the three branches are constructed so that their realized outcomes have diverged by horizon 10 for every source company; an earlier, non-early-branching version of this set had a much smaller fraction of sources diverge by horizon 10 and is not used for the results reported here.

blocks.en: The median-of-medians statistic underlying this permutation test is well-behaved when most companies carry a nonzero clustered value, but degenerates when a majority of the per-company medians tie at exactly the same value (most commonly zero): the observed | median | |\text{median}| then sits at that tied value, resamples that also keep a majority at the same tied value trivially satisfy the meets-or-exceeds criterion, and the permutation p p -value is driven toward 1 regardless of how large the untied companies’ margins are. A mean-based statistic does not share this failure mode, since it is not dominated by a tied majority the way a median is (the within-model action-permutation test described later in this section uses a mean-based statistic for exactly this reason). obs-recursive and obs-direct ’s permutation p = 1.000 p=1.000 alongside a highly significant negative sign test is consistent with this degeneracy; we report their sign-test result, which does not share this failure mode, and omit an unverified permutation p p -value for those two rows in the main text (Table 6 ).

blocks.en: Appendix G Case Study Examples
blocks.zh: 附录G 案例研究

blocks.en: We examine paired examples to illustrate when a latent-based world model improves over an obs-direct predictor (Tables 15 – 17 ). The shared pattern is that the target requires maintaining or updating a state, rather than directly reusing a past observation. In Jericho, the latent model retains an oven’s availability despite intervening failed actions, preserves access to a grimoire in an opened container, and predicts the destination of a navigation sequence where obs-direct returns the preceding location. In ScienceWorld, it tracks movement through an unobserved action window, replaces an outdated kitchen description with the correct hallway observation, and predicts a successful drawer-opening action where obs-direct returns an invalid-action message. In CEO, the examples span subscriber depletion, sustained decline, and net growth: the latent predictions better reflect the accumulated change in subscriber stock, whereas obs-direct either retains outdated values or predicts an unsupported collapse.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了成对的例子,以说明潜在世界模型在改进时会比模糊直接预测器(表15 — — 17 )好。 共同的规律是目标需要保持或更新一个状态,而不是直接重用过去的观察. 在杰里科,潜在的模型保留了炉子的可用性,尽管干预失败了行动,保留了打开的容器内取出一头宝石的通道,并预测了导航序列的去向,其中暗中返回了前一个位置。 在"科学世界"(ScienceWorld)中,它通过一个无人观察的动作窗口来跟踪运动,用正确的走廊观察来取代一个过时的厨房描述,并预测一个成功的抽屉打开动作,其中obs直接返回一个无效动作消息. 在CEO中,例子跨越用户枯竭、持续下降和净增长:潜在预测更好地反映了用户股票的累积变化,而间接地要么保留过时价值,要么预测无根据的崩溃。

blocks.en: These cases illustrate a conditional advantage, rather than establishing that longer histories or more state-changing actions inherently favor latent models. In the accompanying paired analysis, the mean latent-minus-obs-direct difference is + 0.084 +0.084 BLEU for Jericho examples with low target–history lexical overlap ( R < 0.3 R<0.3 ), + 0.092 +0.092 Fact-F1 for ScienceWorld windows containing a room transition, and + 0.059 +0.059 in CEO’s four-field score when no historical snapshot attains a copy score of 0.9 0.9 . Here, lexical R R is the maximum token-set F1 between the target and any historical observation; CEO copy scores use the same four-field metric as model evaluation. These are retrospective, dataset-specific strata, not a common scale or evidence that retrievability is the strongest factor in every dataset. The nine examples are selected illustrations, not independent significance tests or causal evidence about the model’s internal computation. Remaining errors also limit the interpretation: Jericho’s correct room text can coexist with an incorrect game score, and CEO’s improved terminal stocks do not imply accurate intermediate flows or all-field forecasts.
blocks.zh: 这些案例说明了一种有条件的优势,而不是确定长期历史或更多改变国家的行动在本质上有利于潜在的模式。 在配套的配对分析中,目标-历史词汇重叠度低的杰里科实例的平均潜在-最小-直径差为+0.084+0.084 BLEU(R < 0.3 R<0.3),+ 0.092+0.092 F1 fact-F1 for ScienceWorld窗口包含一个房间过渡,当没有历史快照获得0.9 0.9分的复制分时,CEO的四地分中+0.059分+0.059分. 在这里,Lexical R是目标与任何历史观察之间的最大符号集F1;CEO复制分数作为模型评价使用相同的四地度量. 这些是追溯性,数据集特有的分层,而不是一个通用的尺度或证据,表明每个数据集中可检索性最强的因素. 这9个例子都是选定的插图,而不是关于模型内部计算的独立意义测试或因果关系证据. 剩余的错误也限制了解释: 杰里科正确的房间文字可以与不正确的游戏分数并存,CEO改进的终端股票并不意味着准确的中间流或全场预测.
